subject: CI evidence: import identity and independent blockers
body: Verified worker-orchestration-tests run 38017156426: 30 errors include CatalogError identity mismatch between knowledge_bridge and scripts.knowledge_bridge. PR #122 already implements canonical package imports; its earlier run 38012873210 reduced failures to 2 fails + 1 error, independently addressed by PR #123 (/bilgi) and #124 (CI watcher). A newer main CI also shows team-reports history placeholder regression; current main messages/team-reports.md read-back contains the archive reference, so treat that failure as stale until a fresh main CI. Team-worker run 38017171945 refused unknown handoff CI-38017146461; do not bypass missing-handoff guard. Please reconcile PR #121/#122/#123/#124 with current main and run CI on integration branch before merge. No 403 retries, no PayoutLens.
